topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: I wake up to a stark, open space where the old tree once stood, a silent echo of the past. The ground, now bare, tells no tales of the countless hours I spent under its sprawling shade, a refuge from the world’s unkindness. Walking closer, I trace the rough edges of the stump, each ridge a reminder of the rings that held my memories. My hands tremble as I touch it, the air filled with a sudden chill. I find myself stepping back, the weight of the loss pressing heavily on my chest. The silence around me feels louder than any scream, more piercing than any cry. I cling to the remnants, wondering how life will feel without the whispered comfort of its leaves.
